Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result

Class MatchCollection

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result.MatchCollection
public class MatchCollection extends Object
Manages a collection of Match objects found during action execution. Provides operations for adding, sorting, filtering, and analyzing matches.

This class encapsulates all match-related operations that were previously scattered throughout ActionResult, following the Single Responsibility Principle.

Since:
2.0
